figurative_meaning_en: Driven mad by grief and sorrow
similar_in_english: Heartbroken to the point of insanity
example_sentences_in_bangla: সন্তানের মৃত্যুতে তার কলজে পুড়ে খাঁক হয়ে গেছে।
বিচ্ছেদের যন্ত্রণায় তার কলজে পুড়ে খাঁক।
example_sentences_in_english: He was driven mad by grief after his child's death.
Her heart burned to ashes in sorrow from the separation.
note: The idiom uses 'কলজে' as a variant of 'কলিজে', referring to the liver as the seat of emotions in traditional Bengali expression.
